skill.name: shopify-automation
skill.description: Automate Shopify products, orders, customers, collections, inventory, and GraphQL workflows through the Rube MCP Shopify toolkit.
skill.summary: Manage common Shopify store operations through Rube MCP with schema lookup before each workflow.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static shell-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around MCP and Shopify tool names. The real risks are the required third-party Rube MCP OAuth connection and documented Shopify write operations, which need clear consent and permission boundaries.

remediation.issue: External Rube MCP endpoint and Shopify OAuth trust boundary
remediation.suggestion: Document the third-party provider, expected Shopify OAuth scopes, and user consent requirement before connection setup.

remediation.issue: Write-capable Shopify operations can alter products and collections
remediation.suggestion: Require a preview and explicit user confirmation before bulk product creation, smart collection creation, or collection membership changes.

remediation.issue: No explicit least-privilege guidance for Shopify access
remediation.suggestion: Recommend restricted Shopify permissions that match the requested workflow and avoid write scopes for read-only tasks.

content.value_statement: Shopify store tasks often require many API tools and careful pagination. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for common store operations.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for a Rube MCP Shopify connection and OAuth status check.
Directs the agent to search current Rube tool schemas before using Shopify tools.
Lists, retrieves, counts, and bulk creates Shopify products through documented tool names.
Retrieves orders, fulfillment details, fulfillment events, and customer lists with filters.
Manages smart collections and adds products to collections when authorized.
Checks inventory levels, lists locations, and supports advanced Shopify GraphQL workflows.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP connection and a Shopify OAuth authorization.
Does not include built-in safeguards for destructive or write-heavy Shopify actions.
Tool schemas may change, so the agent must search current schemas before each workflow.
Large stores still need pagination handling and Shopify rate limit awareness.

use_cases.title: Review Product Catalogs
use_cases.description: List products, inspect individual product records, and count catalog items before merchandising updates.

use_cases.title: Track Orders and Fulfillment
use_cases.description: Filter orders by status, inspect order details, and review fulfillment events for support questions.

use_cases.title: Monitor Inventory by Location
use_cases.description: Check inventory levels across locations and prepare stock reports for replenishment planning.

prompt_templates.title: Check Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm that Rube MCP is available, search for the current Shopify tool schemas, and verify whether my Shopify connection is active.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Orders
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Shopify tools through Rube MCP to list recent open orders. Include payment status, fulfillment status, and order identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Inventory Levels
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the current Shopify schemas, list store locations, and check inventory levels for these inventory item IDs across relevant locations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Catalog Updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Search current tool schemas, review products for this vendor, identify collection membership, and propose any product or collection changes before applying them.

output_examples.input: Show me open Shopify orders from the last week.
output_examples.output: A concise order summary with order IDs, financial status, fulfillment status, and next review actions.

output_examples.input: Check stock for these inventory items at all locations.
output_examples.output: A location-by-location inventory report that highlights low stock and missing location data.

output_examples.input: Prepare a smart collection for sale products.
output_examples.output: A proposed collection plan with rule criteria, affected products, and confirmation steps before creation.

best_practices: Search Rube tool schemas before each task because Shopify tool inputs can change.
Confirm the active Shopify connection and intended store before reading or changing data.
Ask for explicit approval before bulk product creation, collection changes, or GraphQL mutations.
anti_patterns: Do not assume default order filters include every order status.
Do not run bulk create or collection updates without a preview and user confirmation.
Do not ignore pagination, cursor handling, or Shopify rate limits on large stores.

faq.question: Does this skill require Shopify API keys?
faq.answer: The skill expects Rube MCP and Shopify OAuth authorization. It does not include direct API key setup.

faq.question: Can it create Shopify products?
faq.answer: Yes, it documents bulk product creation through the Shopify toolkit when the connected account has permission.

faq.question: Can it manage orders?
faq.answer: It can list orders with filters, retrieve order details, and inspect fulfillment information through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it support inventory workflows?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide inventory level checks and location listing through the documented Shopify tools.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the agent use current inputs and avoid stale parameters.

faq.question: What permissions should users review?
faq.answer: Users should review Shopify OAuth scopes, store identity, and any write permissions before running workflows.
